infobox.usage: Unlocks the second floor of the bunkhouse at the construction site on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Construction site bunkhouse key (Construct.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the locked bunkhouse at the city construction site.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door on the second floor of the bunkhouse which is located at the construction site at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Jacket
- 1x Medcase
- 1x Sport bag
- Loose loot (Medical supplies)
